# Heart Emoji

> Heart Emoji provides the most comprehensive collection of heart emojis and love symbols. One-click copy to easily express your love and emotions with various heart styles.

This file provides structured information about the Heart Emoji website to help Large Language Models (LLMs) understand its content and purpose.

## Core Features
- **Comprehensive Emoji Library**: Access the complete and up-to-date Unicode emoji library.
- **One-Click Copy**: Instantly copy any emoji to your clipboard with a single click.
- **Emoji Collections**: Explore curated thematic collections like Hearts, Fire, and Laughing.
- **Emoji Categories**: Browse emojis by official Unicode categories such as Smileys, Animals, and Objects.
- **Emoji Kitchen**: Mix two emojis to create unique and fun new emoji stickers.
- **Emoji Search**: Quickly find the perfect emoji with our powerful search functionality.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://heartemoji.im/)
- [Emoji Kitchen](https://heartemoji.im/kitchen/): Mix and create custom emoji combinations using Google's Emoji Kitchen.
- [Collections](https://heartemoji.im/collection/): Browse emojis grouped by themes.
- [Categories](https://heartemoji.im/category/): Browse emojis grouped by official Unicode categories.
- [Blog](https://heartemoji.im/blog/): Updates and articles related to emojis.

## Emoji Collections
- [Heart Emojis](https://heartemoji.im/collection/heart/): Heart Emoji provides the most comprehensive collection of heart emojis and love symbols. One-click copy for red hearts ❤️, pink hearts 🩷, and colorful heart emojis 💛💚💙💜 to express your love!
- [Crying Emojis](https://heartemoji.im/collection/crying/): Express your emotions with our complete collection of crying and sad emojis. One-click copy for tears 😭, sadness 😢, and emotional expressions 😿🥺 to show your feelings!
- [Fire Emojis](https://heartemoji.im/collection/fire/): Get fired up with our complete collection of fire and hot emojis. One-click copy for flames 🔥, explosions 💥, and burning expressions ❤️‍🔥🌶️ to show your passion!
- [Skull Emojis](https://heartemoji.im/collection/skull/): Express your dark side with our complete collection of skull and spooky emojis. One-click copy for skulls 💀, death ☠️, and scary expressions 👻👹 to show your edgy mood!
- [Laughing Emojis](https://heartemoji.im/collection/laughing/): Spread joy with our complete collection of laughing and funny emojis. One-click copy for laughter 😂, giggles 😆, and humorous expressions 🤣😹 to brighten your conversations!

## Emoji Categories
- [Smileys & Emotion](https://heartemoji.im/category/smileys_emotion/): 16 subgroups with 162 emojis.
- [People & Body](https://heartemoji.im/category/people_body/): 16 subgroups with 361 emojis.
- [Animals & Nature](https://heartemoji.im/category/animals_nature/): 8 subgroups with 151 emojis.
- [Food & Drink](https://heartemoji.im/category/food_drink/): 7 subgroups with 126 emojis.
- [Travel & Places](https://heartemoji.im/category/travel_places/): 11 subgroups with 218 emojis.
- [Activities](https://heartemoji.im/category/activities/): 5 subgroups with 85 emojis.
- [Objects](https://heartemoji.im/category/objects/): 18 subgroups with 259 emojis.
- [Symbols](https://heartemoji.im/category/symbols/): 14 subgroups with 222 emojis.
- [Flags](https://heartemoji.im/category/flags/): 3 subgroups with 268 emojis.
